Project overview

A completed project of about 12 duplex villas in Kamala, a short distance from the beach. The 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom homes have around 150 sqm of built area, a private pool and a small garden, with mountain views. Shared services include security, a gym and an estate manager.

Facilities & amenities

  • Private pool
  • Small private garden
  • 24-hour security
  • CCTV
  • Gym
  • Estate manager
  • Car parking
  • Pets allowed
